title: MAKE book launch: a crowdsourced bootstrapping book goes live on Product Hunt
summary: Pieter Levels announces his book MAKE on Product Hunt after 2.5 years of work. It is a crowdsourced book on bootstrapping indie startups to profitability. The post is a short launch announcement with little tactical depth.

principles.text: Involve your audience in creating the product; a crowdsourced book builds community buy-in.
principles.quote: It's a crowdsourced book (partly written by you) on how to bootstrap indie startups to profitability

principles.text: Launch on Product Hunt to reach the startup audience your product serves.
principles.quote: My book on startups called MAKE is now LIVE on Product Hunt
